definition: D3 base_face_by_range: |cz - h/2| (the GT box's base height above the ground plane, metres) for ground-standing classes, by BEV range of the box. A range bin is LOW-TRUST when more than low_trust_frac of its boxes have |base height| > 1.5 m; near_field_m (derived by the loader) is the lowest lower edge of a low-trust bin. A z / h error measured against a GT whose own base face floats by > 1.5 m measures the label, not the head.

provenance.stream: refcv8 data audit D3 (RESULT.md: 'treat z as near-field only')
provenance.low_trust_frac_note: 0.05 is this file's tolerance, chosen between D3's 0.0091 (near) and 0.117 (mid); both sides are >= 4x away from it
